scenario_a_success.name: Scenario A: Clean Parallel Swarm Success
scenario_a_success.description: Full end-to-end appraisal with 3 concurrent collectors, verified evidence, clean merge, and HoD approval.

reviewer.comments: All claims verified against institutional records. Recommended for promotion.

scenario_b_missing_evidence.name: Scenario B: Research Evidence Missing
scenario_b_missing_evidence.description: Research claim lacks supporting evidence document in official registry; score flagged provisional and publication blocked.

scenario_c_mismatched_evidence.name: Scenario C: Teaching Evidence Mismatched
scenario_c_mismatched_evidence.description: Teaching delivery certificate is registered under Research category; validation flags mismatch and blocks publication.

scenario_d_collector_failure.name: Scenario D: Specialist Collector Failure
scenario_d_collector_failure.description: One collector (Research) encounters synthetic database connection failure; Teaching and Admin outputs are preserved, and merge reports partial collection.

scenario_e_consent_denied.name: Scenario E: Source Consent Denied (Consent-Limited)
scenario_e_consent_denied.description: Faculty withholds consent for Research collection; Research collector skips and records denial, category is marked NOT_COLLECTED_CONSENT_DENIED (not verified zero), score is marked CONSENT_LIMITED, and publication is blocked without an authorized override.

scenario_f_unauthorized_reviewer.name: Scenario F: Unauthorized Reviewer
scenario_f_unauthorized_reviewer.description: Approval attempted by an unauthorized role (Student Representative); governance gate rejects attempt and blocks publication.

scenario_g_human_rejection.name: Scenario G: Human Rejection by Dean
scenario_g_human_rejection.description: Collection and evidence validation succeed, but Dean exercises academic oversight and rejects report for insufficient contact hours.

reviewer.comments: Instructional delivery hours documentation does not meet minimum 120 contact hour requirement.
